pairs.target: yīwén de xíngli bǐ láishí duō le liǎngbāo zhǐ .
pairs.english: Iven's luggage contained two more bundles of paper than when he arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文的行李比来时多了两包纸。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dào chēxíng sòng tā , jiàn shī nán zhèng tóng chēfū shuō xià yízhàn de xiàchē chù , biàn méiyǒu qù pèng nà zhī sāi dé gǔgǔde dàizǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi went to the transport office to see him off. Seeing Shinan discussing the next stop's drop-off point with the driver, he left the bulging bag alone.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维到车行送他，见施南正同车夫说下一站的下车处，便没有去碰那只塞得鼓鼓的袋子。

pairs.target: yīwén zìjǐ jiāng tā bào shàng xītóu , téngchū yìzhī shǒu , jiēguò tǎ wéi dàilái de bǐng .
pairs.english: Iven lifted it onto his knees himself, freeing one hand to take the flatbread Tavi had brought.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文自己将它抱上膝头，腾出一只手，接过塔维带来的饼。

pairs.target: " zhè yìhuí shì rè de . " tǎ wéi shuō . yīwén bāi le yìjiǎo , rèqì mào dào liǎnshàng .
pairs.english: “It's hot this time,” Tavi said. Iven broke off a corner, and steam rose into his face.
pairs.hanzi:
“这一回是热的。”塔维说。
伊文掰了一角，热气冒到脸上。

pairs.target: " nǐ yàoshi měi huí dōu zhèyàng , wǒ jiù yuànyì duō lái jǐtàng . "
pairs.english: “If you're like this every time, I'll gladly come a few more times.”
pairs.hanzi: “你要是每回都这样，我就愿意多来几趟。”

pairs.target: chēzi dòng shí , tāmen dōu méiyǒu zài tí shāngháng nàge dàibàn .
pairs.english: When the cart moved, neither mentioned the trading firm's broker again.
pairs.hanzi: 车子动时，他们都没有再提商行那个代办。

pairs.target: yīwén shēnshǒu pāilepāi kuà dài , tǎ wéi zhīdào zuówǎn dehuà méi suízhe lěng bǐng chī wán , què yě búbì jīntiān dāngzhe shī nán de miàn shuō qīng .
pairs.english: Iven reached out and patted his shoulder bag. Tavi knew last night's conversation hadn't ended with the cold flatbread, but it didn't need settling today in front of Shinan either.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文伸手拍了拍挎袋，塔维知道昨晚的话没随着冷饼吃完，却也不必今天当着施南的面说清。

pairs.target: tā zhàn dào chēwěi zhuǎnguò jiējiǎo , cái huíshōu huò chù .
pairs.english: He stayed until the back of the cart rounded the corner, then returned to the receiving office.
pairs.hanzi: 他站到车尾转过街角，才回收货处。

pairs.target: wēn xiù zhèngzài xǐ xiùkǒu shàng de yíkuài lán yìn . tā shūfù de yìn bù zuōfang huàn le dǎoxiàng jià , wǔhòu yào shì tóu yìpī cháng bù , quē gèrén jì měi duàn bù biān piān chūqù duōshǎo .
pairs.english: Wenxiu was washing a blue stain from her cuff. Her uncle's cloth-printing workshop had replaced its guide frame and would test the first batch of long cloth that afternoon; they needed someone to record how far each section's edge wandered.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫正在洗袖口上的一块蓝印。她叔父的印布作坊换了导向架，午后要试头一批长布，缺个人记每段布边偏出去多少。

pairs.target: tā wèn tǎ wéi xiǎng buxiǎng qù kàn , gōngshí àn bàntiān jì , ruǎn héng yǐ dāying ràngchū xiàwǔ .
pairs.english: She asked whether Tavi wanted to watch. The hours would count as half a day's work, and Ruan Heng had already agreed to release him for the afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 她问塔维想不想去看，工时按半天记，阮衡已答应让出下午。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huíqù qǔ chǐ shí , ruǎn héng yòu jiāng jiālǐ jì lái de ruǎnbù yàng jiāogěi tā , xiān shuō qīng shì nǚér xīnxié mó jiǎo , xiǎng qǐng zuōfang de rén kànkàn néngfǒu zhǎo kuài xiāngjìn de báo liào .
pairs.english: When Tavi went back for his ruler, Ruan Heng gave him the soft cloth sample sent from home, explaining first that his daughter's new shoes rubbed her feet and asking if the workshop could find a similar thin fabric.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维回去取尺时，阮衡又将家里寄来的软布样交给他，先说清是女儿新鞋磨脚，想请作坊的人看看能否找块相近的薄料。

pairs.target: zuōfang jiù zài shānlù xià yìcéng , yuànlǐ jià zhe jǐdào shài bù de zhúgān .
pairs.english: The workshop was just one level down the mountain road, with several bamboo poles for drying cloth set up in its courtyard.
pairs.hanzi: 作坊就在山路下一层，院里架着几道晒布的竹竿。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi yā jīyào cóng wūdǐng luòxiàlái , jìnmén què zhī kànjiàn yìzhāng kuān mùchuáng , bù juàn cóng yìtóu fàngchū , pù guò píngzhěng de táimiàn , lìngyìtóu yǒurén mànmàn shōu .
pairs.english: Tavi had imagined a press dropping from the roof. Inside, though, he saw only a broad wooden bed: cloth unrolled from one end, spread across the flat surface, and was slowly gathered by someone at the other.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为压机要从屋顶落下来，进门却只看见一张宽木床，布卷从一头放出，铺过平整的台面，另一头有人慢慢收。

pairs.target: kè zhe huāwén de mùbǎn zhe le sè , fānxiàlái yā yíduàn , zài tíqǐ , xiàngqián nuó yíduàn . xīnzhuāng de dǎoxiàng jià zhǐguǎn bù biān , yìnhuā de mùbǎn réng yóu rén tái .
pairs.english: The patterned wooden block was inked, lowered to print a section, lifted, then moved forward one section. The new guide frame controlled only the cloth edge; people still lifted the printing block.
pairs.hanzi: 刻着花纹的木版着了色，翻下来压一段，再提起，向前挪一段。新装的导向架只管布边，印花的木版仍由人抬。

pairs.target: wēn xiù de shūfù bǐ tā ǎi bàngè tóu , ěr hòu jiá zhe liǎngzhī cū bǐ . tā ná bù yàng tiē dào zhǎngshàng , jiào huǒjì qù jiùliào jiàshàng fān , bù jí zhe tán jiàqián , xiān zhuī zhe wēn xiù kàn zuórì de shì yìn .
pairs.english: Wenxiu's uncle was half a head shorter than her, with two thick pens behind his ear. He laid the sample against his palm and sent a worker to search the old fabric rack. Instead of discussing price, he first followed Wenxiu to inspect yesterday's trial print.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫的叔父比她矮半个头，耳后夹着两支粗笔。他拿布样贴到掌上，叫伙计去旧料架上翻，不急着谈价钱，先追着温岫看昨日的试印。

pairs.target: liǎngduǒ lánhuā zài jiētóuchù jǐchéng yìduǒ . shūfù shuō dǎo jià zhuāng wāi le , wēn xiù ràng tā jiāng yā zhe bù wěi de shǒu táiqǐ lái . tā bùkěn , shuō jǐshínián dōu zhème fú .
pairs.english: Two blue flowers had crowded into one at the join. Her uncle said the guide was crooked; Wenxiu told him to lift the hand pinning the cloth's tail. He refused, saying he'd held it like that for decades.
pairs.hanzi: 两朵蓝花在接头处挤成一朵。叔父说导架装歪了，温岫让他将压着布尾的手抬起来。他不肯，说几十年都这么扶。

pairs.target: wēn xiù yě méi zhēng , zhī zài bù biān huà yìxiǎo dào fěnxiàn . bǎn zǐ tíqǐ shí , shūfù shùnshǒu cháo shēn qián yídài , fěnxiàn biàn líkāi le kèdù .
pairs.english: Wenxiu didn't argue, only drawing a short chalk line at the cloth edge. When the block rose, her uncle casually tugged toward himself, and the chalk line moved off the scale.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫也没争，只在布边画一小道粉线。版子提起时，叔父顺手朝身前一带，粉线便离开了刻度。

pairs.target: wēn xiù kàn tā yìyǎn , tā dītóu kàn xiàn , jiāng ěr hòu de bǐ huàn dào lìngyìbiān . " nǐ bù fú , wǒ xīnlǐ méidǐ . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: Wenxiu glanced at him. He looked down at the line and moved the pen behind his ear to the other side. “Without holding it, I feel unsure,” he said.
pairs.hanzi:
温岫看他一眼，他低头看线，将耳后的笔换到另一边。
“你不扶，我心里没底。”他说。

pairs.target: " wǒ méi jiào nǐ rēng le tā . shùnzhe zǒu , biétì tā guǎiwān . "
pairs.english: “I didn't tell you to drop it. Follow it along. Don't turn it yourself.”
pairs.hanzi: “我没叫你扔了它。顺着走，别替它拐弯。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài pángbiān jì le sānduàn shù . hòu yíduàn méi zàijǐ huā , bù wěi què cóng shōu juàn de rén shǒuzhōng huá le yìdiǎn , huāwén cháo lìngyìtóu cuòkāi .
pairs.english: Tavi recorded measurements for three sections beside them. The last no longer crowded the flowers, but the cloth slipped slightly in the winder's hands, shifting the pattern the other way.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在旁边记了三段数。后一段没再挤花，布尾却从收卷的人手中滑了一点，花纹朝另一头错开。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ de rén tíngxià , fàngsōng shōu juàn , chóngxīn pù zhí . zhèlǐ méiyǒu yìzhī zhuāng hǎo jiù néng tì dàjiā guǎnzhù zhěng pǐ bù de jiàzi , měigè rén hái dé děng lìng yígè rén de shǒu .
pairs.english: The courtyard workers stopped, loosened the roll, and laid it straight again. No frame here could manage an entire length of cloth for everyone simply by being installed. Each person still had to wait for another's hands.
pairs.hanzi: 院里的人停下，放松收卷，重新铺直。这里没有一只装好就能替大家管住整匹布的架子，每个人还得等另一个人的手。

pairs.target: shūfù jiào tǎ wéi yāzhù shì yìn de zhǐ jiǎo . tā gāng jiāng chǐzi fàngxià , xiùkǒu jiù cèng dào méi gān de lánsè , zài zhǐ shàng tuō chū yídào wān wěiba .
pairs.english: Her uncle asked Tavi to hold down a corner of the test paper. Just as he set down his ruler, his cuff brushed the wet blue ink and dragged a curved tail across the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 叔父叫塔维压住试印的纸角。他刚将尺子放下，袖口就蹭到没干的蓝色，在纸上拖出一道弯尾巴。

pairs.target: shūfù kàn le piànkè , shuō bú xiàng huā , xiàng tiáo èshòu de yú . " bié gàosù dù chéng . " wēn xiù shuō , " tā huì zhǎo nǐmen zhēng huàfǎ . "
pairs.english: Her uncle studied it a moment and said it looked less like a flower than a starving fish. “Don't tell Du Cheng,” Wenxiu said. “He'll argue about how you've drawn it.”
pairs.hanzi:
叔父看了片刻，说不像花，像条饿瘦的鱼。
“别告诉杜澄。”温岫说，“他会找你们争画法。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rěnbúzhù xiào , xiào dé yì sōngshǒu , zhǐ jiǎo yòu qiàoqǐlái . tā gǎnjǐn yāhuíqù , shǒuxīn yě rǎn le lán .
pairs.english: Tavi couldn't help laughing, loosening his grip so the paper corner curled up again. He hastily pressed it down, staining his palm blue too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忍不住笑，笑得一松手，纸角又翘起来。他赶紧压回去，手心也染了蓝。

pairs.target: shūfù méi zài huànzhǐ , jiù zhe nàtiáo yú wǎng pángbiān tiān le jǐgēn shuǐcǎo , hòulái de rén jiàn le , dōu yǐwéi yuánlái biànshì zhèyàng .
pairs.english: Her uncle didn't replace the paper. He added a few water plants beside the fish; later arrivals all thought it had always been that way.
pairs.hanzi: 叔父没再换纸，就着那条鱼往旁边添了几根水草，后来的人见了，都以为原来便是这样。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn shōugōng , ruǎnbù zhǎodào le , báo dé néng tòuchū zhǐjié , shūfù àn líng liào de jiàqián suàn gěi ruǎn héng .
pairs.english: At closing that evening they found the soft cloth, thin enough to show knuckles through it. Her uncle charged Ruan Heng the offcut price.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚收工，软布找到了，薄得能透出指节，叔父按零料的价钱算给阮衡。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi lìngwài mǎi le yìtiáo yìn huài de zhǎi bù , lánhuā jiàngé bùqí , zuìhòu yì jié què hěn gānjìng . tā xiǎngdào sè lā fèngyīfu shí zǒng ná suìliào juàn zhēn , wèn néng bunéng jiāng nà yì jié liúxià .
pairs.english: Tavi separately bought a narrow misprinted strip. Its blue flowers were unevenly spaced, but the final section was clean. Remembering Sela always rolled her needles in scraps while sewing, he asked to keep that section.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维另外买了一条印坏的窄布，蓝花间隔不齐，最后一截却很干净。他想到瑟拉缝衣服时总拿碎料卷针，问能不能将那一截留下。

pairs.target: wēn xiù yòng jiǎnzǐ jiǎnkāi , shùnshǒu bǎ yú nà bànzhāng zhǐ yě dìgěi tā . tā yǐwéi tā yào liú zuò jìcuò de píngjù , tā shuō zìjǐ zhī jì chǐcùn , yú guī zuòzhě dàizǒu .
pairs.english: Wenxiu cut it with scissors and handed him the half-sheet with the fish too. He'd thought she would keep it as a record of his mistake; she said she recorded only dimensions, and the artist could take his fish away.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫用剪子剪开，顺手把鱼那半张纸也递给他。他以为她要留作记错的凭据，她说自己只记尺寸，鱼归作者带走。

pairs.target: shàngpō shí tǎ wéi liǎngzhīshǒu dōu bùnéng cā bízi . tā yòng shǒuwàn cèng le yíxià , wēn xiù kànjiàn , xiān bù shuō , dào miànbāo pù ménkǒu cái gàosù tā bíjiān yě lán le .
pairs.english: Walking uphill, Tavi couldn't wipe his nose with either hand. He rubbed it with his wrist. Wenxiu saw but said nothing until they reached the bakery door, then told him his nose was blue too.
pairs.hanzi: 上坡时塔维两只手都不能擦鼻子。他用手腕蹭了一下，温岫看见，先不说，到面包铺门口才告诉他鼻尖也蓝了。

pairs.target: lóushàng de ruǎn héng tīngjiàn xiàoshēng , tàn chūtóu lái , xiān wèn bù mǎi zhe méiyǒu , suíhòu kàn le tǎ wéi hǎo yíhuìer , cái jiāng máojīn diūxiàlái .
pairs.english: Upstairs, Ruan Heng heard laughter and leaned out, first asking if they'd bought the cloth. Then he studied Tavi for quite a while before dropping down a towel.
pairs.hanzi: 楼上的阮衡听见笑声，探出头来，先问布买着没有，随后看了塔维好一会儿，才将毛巾丢下来。
